title: Structure Pack Duo #35 (임산부 큰 조각 4개·매끈 / 임산부 비대칭 몬드리안·물결 | 스테인드글라스+인어비늘+석재+금박 / 금박+뱀비늘+나비날개비늘+코이비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Ethiopian, in her early 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a short pixie cut, real pores, real living eyes, 3 hoops piercings set with diamonds in brass-toned metal, wearing a single piece of gold earrings. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper right edge of her figure to the lower left edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 30% of the way along its length and runs to the upper left edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 80% of the way along its length and runs to the lower right edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper right): it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper left): it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower right): it carries solid polished rose-quartz stone fused directly into her own form, soft natural veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING soft pink stone surface with VIVID white vein striations. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower left): it carries applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Egyptian, in her early 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in low bun, real pores, real living eyes, 150 bars piercings set with opals in copper-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of platinum a hair ornament. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 37% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 62% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 42% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
